facts.claim: arXiv now caps every author at 2 submissions per month (and 3 active at once) — a stopgap against a flood of AI-written papers.
arXiv received a record 40,363 submissions in September 2026 — double September 2024 (20,569) and 4x September 2016 (9,869).
cs.AI submissions to arXiv grew more than 6x in two years.
21% of ICLR 2026 peer reviews were fully AI-generated; more than half showed signs of AI use.
ICLR 2026: 19,525 submissions, 76,139 reviews — submissions up ~6x since 2022 (3,391).
NeurIPS 2026 received 30,709 main-track submissions — triple 2022 (10,411).
NeurIPS 2026 desk-rejected 18.4% of position-paper submissions (178 of 969) as AI-generated.
75% of all new code at Google is now AI-generated, up from 50% last fall and 25% in 2024.
Anthropic's CFO: "90 plus percent of our code is actually written by Claude Code."
New-grad hiring is down ~65% at Big Tech and ~76% at early-stage startups vs 2019; new grads are just 8% of Big Tech hires.
Employment of software developers aged 22-25 has fallen ~20% from its late-2022 peak while developers over 35 kept growing.
facts.source: Stanford Digital Economy Lab, Canaries (Aug 2026) / Semafor

facts.claim: AI was cited in 101,743 announced U.S. job cuts in H1 2026 (~23% of all) — already nearly double the 54,836 AI-attributed cuts in all of 2025.
Block cut more than 4,000 jobs (~40% of staff), citing AI; Jack Dorsey said most companies will do the same.
Undergraduate computer science enrollment fell 8.4% in spring 2026; graduate CS enrollment fell 14%.
Software-development job postings on Indeed sit ~23% below Feb 2020 (index 76.5), down ~67% from the 2022 peak.
On CAD Bench V3, Claude Opus 5.5 scores 84.66 on turning engineering drawings into parametric CAD models; Opus 5 -> 5.5 gained 22 points on that task in one release.
Tavus Griffin: 48% (26 of 54) of people on a one-minute live video call believed it was a real human; Tavus's previous system fooled 2.4% (1 of 41).
Griffin "generates every pixel in every frame in real time from one reference image" — face, hands, chair, shadows and background.
Humans spot AI-generated videos from 2026 generators only 52.6% of the time — essentially a coin flip.
85% of adults say they can no longer tell real from AI-generated content, up from 66% in 2025.
π0 is literally a pre-trained VLM (SigLIP 400M + Gemma 2.6B) plus a 300M-parameter 'action expert'.
Figure's Helix 2.5 worked in 30 homes it had never seen, with zero data collected there; pretraining on human video raised zero-shot success from 9% to 56%.
